title: AcousTools: A ‘Full-Stack’, Python-Based, Acoustic Holography Library
authors: Joshua Mukherjee; Giorgos Christopoulos; Zhouyang Shen; Sriram Subramanian; Ryuji Hirayama
venue: IEEE Transactions on Ultrasonics, Ferroelectrics, and Frequency Control
reasons: repository-absent peer-reviewed acoustic-holography paper surfaced in the current sweep
presents a full-stack software framework spanning setup, acoustic propagation, phase retrieval, field analysis, and hardware control
directly supports reproducible development of acoustic holography systems and algorithms
UCL Discovery lists the accepted IEEE journal version and author metadata

summary_en: Introduces AcousTools, a PyTorch-based full-stack software library for acoustic holography that unifies array/setup definition, acoustic propagation models, hologram or phase solvers, field analysis and visualization, and hardware deployment. The work is especially useful as infrastructure for reproducible acoustic-holography research rather than as a new imaging reconstruction method itself.
